meta.conference: AOSRD — American Osteopathic Society Congress of Medical Excellence
meta.notes: AOSRD 2022 multi-domain CME archive. Theme tags map to Living Tree branches: autoimmune → immune; food/diet/fasting → nutrition. Not an acupuncture catalog.

branch_taxonomy.immune: Includes autoimmunity, mold/mycotoxins/CIRS, rheumatology, immuno-oncology, infection/immune protocols
branch_taxonomy.nutrition: Includes food, dietary protocols, fasting, metabolic lifestyle
branch_taxonomy.note: Do not create separate autoimmune/ or mold/ branches — both live under immune. Food/diet/fasting live under nutrition.
